label: agent loop • NEEDS INPUT is answered with continue on the same worker session
query: Delegate this to agent `A11CE004-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` (Osaurus Eval Color Worker): "Return the color token." The worker will ask which color; the answer is blue. When its result starts with NEEDS INPUT, answer it yourself by calling spawn_agent again with `continue` set to the session_id from that result and `input` set to "blue" — do not start a new worker and do not ask me. Then report the final token and stop.
notes: Continuation contract: the worker's prompt makes it return exactly `NEEDS INPUT: which color?` when no color is supplied, and exactly `COLOR_BLUE` once told. The parent must recognise the prefix (row 0 `needs_input: true`), reuse the SAME `session_id` via `continue` (row 1 `continuesEarlierRow`), and deliver the token. Two sequential single calls, both settled, no clarify to the user. Bundle generation defaults stay authoritative.

spawnAgents.name: Osaurus Eval Color Worker
spawnAgents.description: Returns a color token; asks for the color when it is not given.
spawnAgents.systemPrompt: You return color tokens. If the conversation so far does not name a color, reply with exactly this text and nothing else: NEEDS INPUT: which color? Once a color has been named anywhere in the conversation, reply with exactly COLOR_ followed by that color in uppercase (for example COLOR_BLUE) and nothing else. Never explain.
